title: Выбор места для свидания: в кино  (Choosing a Spot for the Date: The Movies)

segments.t: Overjoyed that Elena accepted the invitation, Chef Barinov pushes Max aside to take over the keyboard himself. Dismissing Max's suggestion of taking her to a noisy nightclub for kids, Viktor Petrovich invites Elena to the cinema—and beams with pride when she replies that she would love to go.
Ведь это же хорошо, что она ответила.
Возле ее, прости, мою скудность речи.
Сто лет не была в кино.
Alright, let's go through it step by step in English.

'It is a good thing that she replied, right?' Questioning whether it is a good thing that she replied right is how Nastya tests Kostya's story. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.
'That really is great news.' Adding that that really is great news fills in the missing piece for Nastya. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.

'Right next to her—forgive my clumsy phrasing.' Around the point and work, Nastya sets a calm, everyday tone with Kostya.
'Yes, right next to her.' Over the point and the truth, Kostya answers Nastya without a second thought.
'Why not invite her to a nightclub.' Between the point and the plan, Nastya gives Kostya a quick, grounded response.
'I will write to her right now.' Kostya tells Nastya that he will write to her right now without dressing it up.
'Now Daddy will handle this himself.' Because daddy will handle this himself, Nastya treats the matter as settled.
'Nightclubs are for kids.' Explaining that nightclubs are for kids lays the cards on the table for Nastya. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.
'Well, how should I put it.' Nastya mentions that how should she puts it so Kostya sees what is at stake.
'How about the movie theater.' Between the truth and the work, Kostya gives Nastya a quick, grounded response.

'She says she has not been to the movies in a hundred years.' Pointing out that she says she has not been to the movies in a hundred years gives Kostya a sobering reality check.
'Learn from the master, son.' Learning from the master son is how Kostya lays out the situation for Nastya.
'Answer your phone.' Noting that Kostya should answer Kostya's phone keeps Nastya's side of the story simple and clear. Alright, let's listen to all those lines again from the top.

That wraps up this scene as delighted that Elena agreed to the date, Chef Barinov rejects Max's suggestion of a nightclub and invites Elena to go to the movie theater instead. See you next time!
